content.short: Basenames is a native identity and naming service for the Base blockchain, built to simplify Web3.
content.description: Basenames provides user-friendly identity solutions natively on the Base network. By allowing users to claim readable ENS-compatible names instead of long alphanumeric addresses, the platform drastically improves the onboarding experience for both individuals and developers. Developed to integrate seamlessly with Base's growing ecosystem, it serves as a foundational layer for identity, helping users establish persistent digital reputations on-chain.
